messages:
Andrea (All-hands): Thanks everyone for the great questions during the all-hands. Dropping the RCA link, timeline, and a lightweight action list here so we can track owners and due dates. Please ack and add your tasks to projects.redwood.

Maria (SRE): RCA link: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/inc-2026-04-28-rca — TL;DR: memory leak in policy-router causing degraded eviction behavior -> request queue growth -> downstream timeouts. Failover to fallback cluster worked but was manual and too slow.

incident-bot: Incident incident-2026-04-28 closed. Timeline + raw traces: https://internal.redwood/incident/incident-2026-04-28/timeline.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): Confirmed root cause. Plan: hotfix (bounds check + safer alloc), canary on staging, then canary in prod with traffic ramp. Owner: Jamal. Target: staging canary TOMORROW morning, prod canary next Tue.

Sowmya (Product): How many customers were affected and what's our comms plan? Need a short exec summary for customer-facing teams.

Maria (SRE): Impact: ~12 tenants saw increased 5xxs for 8–12 minutes during peak. No data exfiltration.

Andrea (All-hands): Action items I captured (please correct):
1) Hotfix + deploy canaries (owner: Jamal) — due Fri EOD for hotfix; prod canary next Tue.
2) Router metrics + alert (owner: Maria) — add mem/eviction saturation alert and runbook — due Wed.
3) Customer exec summary and comms draft (owner: Sowmya) — due Mon EOD.
4) Postmortem write-up + one-page exec (owner: Andrea) — due Mon.
5) Automation for fallback routing (owner: Maria + eng-platform) — design doc + spike — due in 2 weeks.
6) Add regression test in CI for the allocation pattern (owner: Eng runtime) — due next sprint.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): I’ll post the staging canary link once deployed: https://deploys.redwood/staging/canary-rca-1887. Also adding the CI regression as a follow-up ticket.

Sowmya (Product): I’ll draft the customer note and include impacted tenant list. @Ryan any guidance on tone? Prefer to be concise and show mitigation steps and next steps.

Ryan (CTO): Yes — be transparent, emphasize that failover worked (manual) and we’ve got a timeline for automation. I’ll review the draft.

Maria (SRE): Logs & trace snippet: see https://internal.redwood/logs/trace/abc123 — notable spike at 03:12 UTC when eviction stalled.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): Temporary workaround used during the outage: manual reroute to fallback cluster with reduced concurrency limits. We should automate that path (turn into a policy + a queued job).

Maria (SRE): Agreed. New action added: automation for fallback routing (owner: Maria + eng-platform) — proposing a feature branch and basic playbook first. Due in 2 weeks.

Andrea (All-hands): Please add/check the items in projects.redwood/INC-1887 and tag with "post-allhands-rca". React with :white_check_mark: when done.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): ✅ Added hotfix + CI regression tickets. Will update with canary link after staging deploy.

Sowmya (Product): ✅ Drafting customer note, will post here for review by EOD Mon.

Ryan (CTO): ✅ I’ll review the draft.

Maria (SRE): I added the alert rule and a first-pass runbook to the ops repo; will refine after canary.

incident-bot: Timeline updated with post-incident notes and owner assignments.

Andrea (All-hands): Thanks — if anyone has follow-ups that should be included in the next eng-ops sync, drop them here or DM me. Planning a short 30m checkin Thu to confirm progress.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): Quick note: for the canary I'm going to limit seq_len to 1024 and add KV-cache guard rails to reduce mem. Will share config snippet after deploy.

Maria (SRE): Also adding a Grafana panel to the allhands dashboard showing eviction rate + heap usage.

Sowmya (Product): Team, also flagging this for Customer Success — they may need a customer-by-customer impact table. I'll coordinate.

Andrea (All-hands): Closing loop: thanks for acting fast. If you haven't yet, please add your checkmarks and owners to INC-1887. We'll reconvene Thu 10:00 UTC.
